dedupe_keys.name: dataset 22 android based 4g lte measurements for semi circular uav trajectory around a private aerpaw base station

description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This experiment records Android-based LTE measurements along a semicircular UAV trajectory near a private AERPAW base station. A Samsung S21 running PawPrints logs received signal reference power, reference quality, signal strength, latitude, longitude and altitude. The provider describes one-second CSV observations and links post-processing documentation. These measurements support evaluation of aerial cellular coverage as the UAV changes position relative to the base station. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. Access links are supplied on the provider landing page. Licence, cost and access requirements remain uncertain for the linked release. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Aerial LTE coverage and network planning. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
